summary: Account and social release candidate: consistent sign-in and recovery, verified profile persistence, consent-aware people actions, recent-provider account deletion and branded welcome email. This build adds a confirmable footer newsletter and optional scoped signup email transport. Preserves unified discovery, high-contrast social links, the floating Concierge entry, and multi-location owner integrity with measured activity only. Adds current profile counts, confirmed profile/header identity synchronization, and narrow documented fixture exclusions including review writes and owner review reads. Preserves current sign-in when an older session probe fails and keeps transient probe failures from clearing authentication. Requires the paired API candidate. External provider cleanup and native App Store acceptance remain release gates; AI and provider pilots remain off.
